name: harness-desktop-electron
description: Spike: the Harness desktop app on Electron, with the Browser pane as a real Chromium view

scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --external electron-liquid-glass --outfile dist/main.cjs && bun build src/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile dist/preload.cjs
